Messages.Body:

Steven Sierb <mag...@elvis.umd.umich.edu> wrote:

Malk Dementia: You don't control a Malk who was taken from you with MD,
so you would not untap him on your untap. The new controller loses control
of the Malk *before* her untap, and so would also not untap the Malk.
The Malk would not untap until your following untap phase (when you again had
control of the Malk).

When a thing refers to "your" minions, it means the ones you control, not
the ones that started in your crypt or library.

Messages.Author: Charles Richard Robb
Messages.Body:
Steven Sierb (mag...@elvis.umd.umich.edu) wrote:

: I like to play Malks and unfortuneatly all my opponents have acquired

: the Malk Dementia Card. I have a couple questions about it:
: Example:
: I end my turn with Zebbie Untapped:
: Gangrel meth plays Dementia
: Gangrel meth has Zebbie Bums Rush a peon. Zebbie lives and Taps
: gangrel ends turn.
: I untap my vampires. (Do I untap Zebbie, if I do then Gangrel gets another
: action? Or do I untap Zebbie but I won't be able to use him. gangrel meth
: will not be able to use him beacuse it is not his turn UNLESS Madness net
: is up, in which case he could use Zebbie one more time at the end of my turn
: (or someone else's before mine )

Zebulon will stay tapped when you untap. When the stealers turn comes around, you get your vamp back. If it was tapped at the beginning of his turn, you
get it back tapped otherwise it's untapped. One great way of using Malk Dem
is to burn an opposing vamp with diablerie and then vote the vamp to death.
Also you could attack someone and hope they do aggr. damage to the Malk and the
Malk will go back to you in torpor.
